scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @holoim/contracts build && pnpm --filter @holoim/objects build && pnpm run prisma:setup && tsx watch src/server.ts
scripts.verify:fast: pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test
scripts.verify:full: pnpm run verify:fast && pnpm run build
scripts.prisma:setup: pnpm run prisma:generate && prisma migrate deploy
scripts.worker:usdz: pnpm --filter @holoim/contracts build && pnpm --filter @holoim/objects build && tsx src/worker.ts
scripts.rebuild:usdz: pnpm --filter @holoim/contracts build && pnpm --filter @holoim/objects build && tsx src/rebuild-usdz.ts
